description: This file defines an AuthProvider class that manages user authentication state, session persistence, and interactions with a database service for user registration and login in a Flutter application.

classes.name: AuthProvider
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier that manages user authentication, session persistence, and user management functions.

methods.name: loadSession
methods.description: Loads the user session data from shared preferences and updates the user state.

methods.name: _saveSession
methods.description: Saves the current user session data to shared preferences.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers a new user with email, password, and optional display name, then saves the session.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Authenticates a user with email and password, then saves the session.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Logs out the current user and clears session data.
